There is one advantage SAMAN has in Bangalore that no other container office supplier can match: our factory is here. We build steel container offices at our own facility in Gopasandra, on Sarjapura Hubli Road (560099), and deliver them across Bangalore — Peenya, Bommasandra, Electronic City, Whitefield, and every industrial and construction zone in between.

That is not a sales line. It is a logistics fact with real consequences for you. A Bangalore buyer ordering from us is not waiting on a unit trucked in from another state. The container office is fabricated, fitted, and dispatched from inside the city. Shorter transit. Lower freight. The ability to visit our factory and inspect a unit before you commit.

We are an ISO-certified manufacturer that has built prefab steel structures since 2009. Browse our container office models and sizes or call us directly with your requirement.

What a Container Office Actually Is — and Who Buys One in Bangalore

A container office is a steel office unit built either from a repurposed shipping container or fabricated new on a container-style steel frame. It arrives as a finished, lockable, weatherproof workspace — wired, insulated, and ready to use the day it is placed. No civil construction, no waiting weeks for a brick-and-mortar room.

In Bangalore, the buyers fall into clear groups:

Construction and infrastructure contractors building IT parks, apartment complexes, and commercial towers need a site office for the project manager and a security cabin at the site entry. Bangalore's continuous construction along the Outer Ring Road, Sarjapur Road, and the metro corridors keeps this demand steady.

Manufacturing and industrial units in Peenya, Bommasandra, and the Electronic City belt use container offices as quality-control rooms, supervisor cabins, and additional administrative space when permanent construction is not justified.

IT and tech campuses use them as temporary expansion offices, gate security posts, and contractor coordination rooms during fit-out and expansion phases.

Logistics and warehousing operators along the Hosur Road and Tumkur Road corridors place container offices at yard entries and inside compounds for dispatch supervision.

A container office cabin built on a steel frame suits a permanent on-site office. A repurposed shipping container office suits a buyer who wants the authentic container aesthetic and structure.

Bangalore's Industrial Zones — Where We Deliver

Knowing your delivery zone helps us plan the route and quote accurate freight. We deliver across all of Bangalore, including:

Peenya Industrial Area (PIN 560058): One of Asia's largest industrial estates, Peenya houses engineering, machine tools, and manufacturing units. Container offices here are used as factory administrative cabins, security posts, and contractor site offices during plant expansion.

Bommasandra Industrial Area (PIN 560099): On the Hosur Road belt, Bommasandra hosts pharma, electronics, and engineering firms. This is also where our factory operates — the closest possible dispatch point for any Bommasandra buyer.

Electronic City (PIN 560100): The IT and electronics hub on the southern edge of Bangalore. Tech campus expansion and construction here drives demand for temporary office and security units.

Whitefield / EPIP Zone (PIN 560066): The eastern IT corridor. Container offices serve construction sites, IT park fit-outs, and logistics operations across this fast-growing belt.

Outside these zones, we deliver to construction sites across the city — anywhere a crane or forklift can place the unit.

Sizes and Specifications

Our container offices are built to last on an industrial site. The structure is either a genuine ISO shipping container (refabricated and fitted) or a new steel frame built to container dimensions using IS 2062 grade steel.

Structure: Refabricated ISO shipping container OR new IS 2062 steel frame, anti-rust treated and painted
Insulation: PUF panel or rock wool lining on walls and ceiling — essential in Bangalore for keeping the interior workable through the day
Flooring: Marine plywood, vinyl, or anti-skid steel as specified
Roofing: Container roof with additional weather sealing, or sloped GI sheet over-roof to handle Bangalore monsoon
Electrical: Wiring, MCB board, LED lights, fan and AC points to your declared load
Windows: Sliding glass with MS safety grille; mesh ventilation options
Doors: Container door retained for storage-office combos, or standard MS/glass entry door

Common sizes delivered in Bangalore:

SizeTypical use
10 ftCompact security cabin or single-desk office
20 ftStandard site office — the most common size
40 ftLarge office, or office + storage combination
20 ft + partitionTwo-room layout: office plus meeting or storage
40 ft modularJoined units for a larger workspace

Custom layouts, sizes, and internal partitions are built to your requirement. Tell us your site footprint and we design to it.

Customisation

Everything is built and fitted at our Bangalore factory before dispatch — not improvised at your site.

  • Internal partition walls to create separate rooms
  • Air conditioner provision — cut-out, bracket, copper sleeve, drain
  • Full electrical fit-out with MCB, sockets, LED, fan points
  • Insulated false ceiling for cooling efficiency
  • Attached toilet module with FRP tank and plumbing
  • Pantry counter for longer-stay site offices
  • Sliding windows, additional doors, ventilation louvres
  • Exterior paint in your colour, plus company branding panel
  • Anti-corrosion treatment for long-term outdoor placement

Why Buy From SAMAN — the Home-City Manufacturer

Most container office suppliers in Bangalore are dealers or fabricators reselling units. We manufacture our own.

  • ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management (Certificate E20250218645)
  • ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management (E20250218646)
  • ISO 45001:2018 Occupational Health & Safety (E20250218647)
  • NSIC Registration: NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207
  • DPIIT Recognition: DIPP56005
  • GST: 29ABBCS7101B1ZR

Structural frame warranty: 5 years. Finishing: 1–2 years. Engineered service life: 20–25 years. More than 500 projects completed since 2009.

Because our factory is in Bangalore, you can call +91 88616 22859 and arrange to visit and inspect a unit in progress before placing your order — something an out-of-state supplier cannot offer.

Price Factors

We do not publish a fixed price because every container office is built to specification. Cost depends on:

  • Container vs new steel frame build
  • Size (10 ft / 20 ft / 40 ft)
  • Insulation level and type
  • Electrical and AC fit-out
  • Partition, toilet, and pantry additions
  • Exterior treatment for outdoor durability

Because we dispatch from within Bangalore, freight to a city address is lower than from suppliers shipping in from other states. Call or send an enquiry with your size and use, and we return a written quotation with a full line-item breakup within 24 hours.

You can also see our shipping container office in 20ft and 40ft for standard container conversions.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the price of a container office in Bangalore?

Price depends on size, whether it is a converted shipping container or a new steel-frame build, and the fit-out level. A basic 20 ft unit costs less than a 40 ft fully-fitted office with AC, partition, and toilet. Because we manufacture and dispatch from within Bangalore, freight is lower than from out-of-state suppliers. Call +91 88616 22859 with your requirement for a written quotation with full cost breakup within 24 hours.

How quickly can SAMAN deliver a container office in Bangalore?

Standard sizes are typically ready in 7–12 working days from order confirmation. Since our factory is in Gopasandra (560099), transit to any Bangalore address — Peenya, Bommasandra, Electronic City, Whitefield — is same-day once dispatched. Custom fit-out with AC, partition, and toilet adds a few working days to production.

Can I visit your factory before ordering?

Yes. Our manufacturing facility is at Gopasandra, Sarjapura Hubli Road, Bangalore 560099. You are welcome to inspect a container office in progress or a completed unit before placing your order. Call +91 88616 22859 to schedule a visit with our production team.

Do you deliver container offices to Peenya and Electronic City industrial areas?

Yes. We deliver across all Bangalore industrial zones including Peenya (560058), Bommasandra (560099), Electronic City (560100), and Whitefield / EPIP (560066), plus construction sites anywhere a crane or forklift can place the unit. For industrial estate deliveries needing a gate pass, share the entry procedure when you order.

Call or Send an Enquiry

For a container office in Bangalore — built and delivered by your local manufacturer:

+91 88616 22859 | +91 80886 85440

Call or WhatsApp. Same working day response. Include your size, intended use, and delivery zone, and we return a complete quotation without a follow-up call.

You can also explore our container offices in Bommasandra and container office units in Hoskote for nearby industrial-belt deliveries.
